تستقطعوا (form X)
# تَسْتَقْطِعُوا (tastaqṭiʕū) /tas.taq.tˤi.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْطَعَ (istaqṭaʕa)
# تُسْتَقْطَعُوا (tustaqṭaʕū) /tus.taq.tˤa.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْطَعَ (istaqṭaʕa)
